map.风险溢价是 CAPM 核心输入。: Risk premium is a core CAPM input.
map.市场预期收益减无风险利率，股权风险溢价。: Expected market return minus risk-free rate, the equity risk premium.
map.CAPM、DCF 贴现率的核心输入。: Core input to CAPM and DCF discount rates.
map.MRP = 8% − 3% = 5%。即承担市场系统性风险要求的额外补偿约 5%: MRP = 8% - 3% = 5%. That is, the extra compensation required for bearing market systemic risk is about 5%.
map.无风险 2%、预期 8%：MRP=6%。低利率环境溢价扩张。: Risk-free 2%, expected 8%: MRP = 6%. Low-rate environments expand the premium.
map.常用历史股指超额收益均值、或调查（如 Ibbotson）、或隐含法反推，结果差异: Commonly via the historical mean equity-index excess return, surveys (e.g. Ibbotson), or an implied reverse method; results vary widely.
map.极少见（如市场长期跑输无风险利率），理论上不成立，多因估计窗口特殊。: Extremely rare (e.g. market underperforms the risk-free rate over the long run); theoretically invalid, usually due to a special estimation window.
